panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: All S3 requests seen from this host, per second.

panels.title: Read throughput
panels.description: Response payload bytes per second (object data downloaded).

panels.title: Write throughput
panels.description: Request payload bytes per second (object data uploaded).

panels.title: GET p50 (TTFB)
panels.description: Median time to first byte for full and ranged GETs.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"GET_OBJECT|GET_OBJECT_RANGE"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: GET p99 (TTFB)
panels.description: 99th percentile time to first byte for full and ranged GETs.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"GET_OBJECT|GET_OBJECT_RANGE"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: PUT / part p99
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of PUTs and multipart parts, including the upload itself.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"PUT_OBJECT|MPU_PART"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of requests answered with HTTP 4xx/5xx.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(s3slower_request_errors_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(s3slower_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Events dropped
panels.description: Events lost before export in the selected time range. 0 means every request was captured.

panels.title: Requests / s by operation
panels.description: Request rate by operation family. MPU control = create/complete/abort/list; the table below breaks out every operation.

panels.title: Requests in range by operation
panels.description: Total requests per operation family over the selected time range.

panels.title: Read throughput by operation
panels.description: Response payload bytes per second (data downloaded), by operation family. Families under 1 KB/s are hidden.

panels.title: Write throughput by operation
panels.description: Request payload bytes per second (data uploaded), by operation family. Families under 1 KB/s are hidden.

panels.title: Data-path latency (p99 solid, p50 dashed)
panels.description: GET latency is time to first byte. PUT and MPU part latency runs from the request head to the response, so it includes uploading the body. Log scale.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"GET_OBJECT"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"GET_OBJECT"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"GET_OBJECT_RANGE"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"GET_OBJECT_RANGE"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"PUT_OBJECT|COPY_OBJECT"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"PUT_OBJECT|COPY_OBJECT"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"MPU_PART"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"MPU_PART"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Metadata latency (p99)
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of metadata operations. DELETE includes batch DeleteObjects. Log scale.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"MPU_CREATE|MPU_COMPLETE|MPU_ABORT|MPU_LIST|MPU_LIST_PARTS"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"LIST_PREFIX|LIST_OBJECTS|LIST_BUCKETS"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"HEAD_OBJECT|HEAD_BUCKET"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation=~"DELETE_OBJECT|DELETE_OBJECTS"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint", s3_operation!~"GET_OBJECT|GET_OBJECT_RANGE|PUT_OBJECT|COPY_OBJECT|MPU_PART|MPU_CREATE|MPU_COMPLETE|MPU_ABORT|MPU_LIST|MPU_LIST_PARTS|LIST_PREFIX|LIST_OBJECTS|LIST_BUCKETS|HEAD_OBJECT|HEAD_BUCKET|DELETE_OBJECT|DELETE_OBJECTS"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency distribution (all requests)
panels.description: Requests per latency bucket over time. Brighter cells hold more requests.

panels.title: Per-operation summary (selected time range)
panels.description: Every S3 operation individually. GET latency is time to first byte; PUT/part latency includes the upload. Avg payload is body bytes per request.

targets.expr: sum by (s3_operation) (increase(s3slower_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))
sum by (s3_operation) (rate(s3slower_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))

(sum by (s3_operation) (increase(s3slower_request_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])) + sum by (s3_operation) (increase(s3slower_response_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))) / sum by (s3_operation) (increase(s3slower_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))

sum by (s3_operation) (rate(s3slower_request_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])) + sum by (s3_operation) (rate(s3slower_response_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, s3_operation) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, s3_operation) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])))

sum by (s3_operation) (increase(s3slower_request_errors_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum by (s3_operation) (increase(s3slower_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Requests / s by client
panels.description: Client = well-known tool (awscli, boto3, elbencho, ...) or the process name.

panels.title: p99 latency by client
panels.description: Across all operations, so a client doing large uploads reads higher. Log scale.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, comm) (rate(s3slower_request_duration_ms_bucket{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Throughput by client
panels.description: Upload + download payload bytes per second.

targets.expr: sum by (comm) (rate(s3slower_request_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (comm) (rate(s3slower_response_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", comm=~"$comm", s3_operation=~"$s3_operation", bucket=~"$bucket", endpoint=~"$endpoint"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Responses / s by status class
panels.description: HTTP responses per second, grouped by status class.

panels.title: Errors / s by operation and status
panels.description: 4xx/5xx responses by operation, e.g. 404 on HEAD (missing key) or 503 SlowDown.

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape s3slower.

panels.title: Dropped events / s by reason
panels.description: perf_lost: kernel ring overflow (raise --perf-buffer-kb). channel_full: userspace back-pressure.
